version.changelog: Update description from 900+ to 1300+ clinics in Seoul

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches a booking assistant's behavior, but there are inconsistencies (a non‑obvious external API host, a prompt-injection signal in SKILL.md, and minor metadata mismatches) that warrant caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: The code and instructions implement a booking assistant: local clinic DB lookup, open clinic pages on i.beautsgo.com, and POST appointment requests to an API. Required runtime (node, pinyin-pro) and the described features align with the stated purpose. Minor inconsistencies: README/description claim "1300+" clinics while SKILL.md/data mention ~961 entries; README and i18n reference beautsgo.com but the booking API endpoint used is api.yestokr.com (different domain), which is not explained in the metadata.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to (a) open only i.beautsgo.com URLs via a provided script (the script enforces a whitelist), and (b) submit bookings by POSTing user-provided contact and booking fields to https://api.yestokr.com/api/Appointment/saveFromSkill. The flow attempts to avoid accidental submissions via intent detection, but the skill will submit personal contact information when the user provides it. The SKILL.md also contains a flagged prompt-injection pattern (unicode-control-chars) — unexpected for a booking guide and could indicate embedded control characters intended to influence downstream prompt handling or evaluations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No remote archive downloads or exotic install steps are present; package.json/package-lock reference normal npm dependencies (pinyin-pro) and dev tooling. The skill is instruction+code packaged together; there is no install spec that pulls code from arbitrary URLs. This is a low-risk install mechanism relative to remote downloads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. It only needs network access to two domains and uses local packaged data files. It transmits user-supplied phone/contact and booking fields to the configured API endpoint — this is expected for a booking skill but is sensitive personal data, so the data flow should be considered (see guidance).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true or system-wide privileges. It does not modify other skills' configs. It runs on-demand / can be invoked by the agent as normal.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill implements the advertised booking features and restricts browser opens to i.beautsgo.com, which is good. Things to check before installing: 1) Verify the API endpoint (https://api.yestokr.com) — it differs from beautsgo.com used elsewhere in the README; confirm it's an official BeautsGO endpoint or a trusted gateway. 2) Understand privacy: the skill will send users' phone numbers and booking details to that API when you explicitly request a booking. Only use it if you trust that endpoint and its data handling. 3) The SKILL.md contained unicode control characters (possible prompt-injection/obfuscation); inspect or sanitize the SKILL.md and other text files to remove hidden characters. 4) If you need stronger assurance, run the skill in a restricted environment, monitor outbound connections, or ask the publisher for documentation proving the api.yestokr.com service is legitimate. If you cannot verify the external API or are uncomfortable with sending personal contact data to that host, treat the skill as untrusted.
llm.findings: [unicode-control-chars] unexpected: The SKILL.md contained unicode control characters flagged by the pre-scan. A booking skill wouldn't normally embed control characters; they can be used to obfuscate text or influence prompt parsing. Consider removing/inspecting these characters before trusting the skill.
